title: Rigidity of derived tensor models on cochain representatives
statement:
Let $(\mathcal S,J)$ be a site small relative to a coefficient universe $w$, and let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings in that universe. Use the abelian category $\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], its category $\operatorname{Ch}(R)$ of unbounded cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and its unbounded derived category $D(R)$ with cochain localization $Q:\operatorname{Ch}(R)\to D(R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $\mathcal P$ be the full subcategory of cochain complexes that are K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex] and whose terms are flat module sheaves [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]; flatness here means exactness of tensoring with the sheafified sectionwise tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Write $\iota:\mathcal P\to\operatorname{Ch}(R)$ and $q=Q\iota$. Let $t$ denote signed direct-sum total tensor of complexes [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], and let $T:D(R)\times D(R)\to D(R)$ be the tensor model obtained by localization on flat-term K-flat homotopy representatives [lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent], with its given natural representative comparison there.

There is a natural isomorphism $r:Q\,t(\iota\times\iota)\xrightarrow{\sim}T(q\times q)$ obtained from that homotopy representative comparison using the canonical factorization $Q\cong Q_h\circ\pi$, where $\pi$ is the homotopy quotient and $Q_h$ its derived localization. It uses the same sheaf tensor and the same flatness predicate on cochain representatives. For every bifunctor $T':D(R)\times D(R)\to D(R)$ equipped with a natural isomorphism $r':Q\,t(\iota\times\iota)\xrightarrow{\sim}T'(q\times q)$, there is a unique natural isomorphism $e:T\xrightarrow{\sim}T'$ satisfying $r;e(q\times q)=r'$. Moreover, for every category $\mathcal E$, precomposition with $q\times q$ is fully faithful on functors $D(R)\times D(R)\to\mathcal E$. No functorial choice of K-flat resolutions is required.
